description: An ask raised, put anew, answered, withdrawn, stopped, routed or removed: told every subscribed head that may manage its Bot, as a draft's change is. One that's answered, withdrawn or removed (removed: true) leaves every Inbox.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

ask.description: The ask as it is now.

removed.description: It's gone from the host (a stopped one removed).
